{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where they undershoot true lows",
    "When sentiment turns negative (0.00), model predictions are too slow to react, showing 1-2 day lag",
    "High sentiment (1.00) regions are overfitted to recent momentum, causing prediction overshoot of 0.3-0.5 on first slow days",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes issues in low volatility periods (June 26 example) where true outcomes show more range than predicted",
    "Sentiment zero values (0.00) correlate with flat outcomes but model continues projecting 0.1-0.2 daily changes that don't materialize",
    "Model has difficulty capturing the true volatility clustering - forecast standard deviation is consistently 15-20% too low compared to true outcome volatility",
    "When price has been trading in a narrow 1-2 dollar range for 5+ days, model confidence intervals are too narrow by approximately 30%"
  ]
}
